Mass 0.942 (0.902 to 0.982) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2835207319109249920: teff_gspphot 5662.524 K (16th-84th percentiles 5661.2275-5663.87), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2835207319109249920: teff_gspphot 5662.524 K (16th-84th percentiles 5661.2275-5663.87), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
